title: covid19-seir: an age-structured SEIR model for SARS-CoV-2 RT-PCR prevalence data
description: Python implementation of an age-structured, regional SEIR transmission model for SARS-CoV-2 with an observation model for RT-PCR positivity, and an adaptive random-walk Metropolis-Hastings sampler for fitting it to prevalence survey data. This version was used for the analyses of the ONS Coronavirus (COVID-19) Infection Survey in Blake et al., 'The added value of randomly sampled prevalence surveys to estimate infection incidence and transmission'.
